subtitle.text: Infeed Device for Rollbag R3200 Automatic Bagger

summary.text: The Rollbag Weigh Count Sorting Table is designed to seamlessly integrates to the Rollbag R3200 Automatic Bagger for an all-in-one weigh count bagging solution. The operator places a product into the weigh bucket to set the per piece weight and then chooses the target count per bag. The Weigh Count Sorting table automatically dispenses product into the Rollbag R3200 once the target count has bee reached. The Weigh Count Sorting Table has an accuracy of 0.003 oz (0.1 g) and a max bucket weight of 6.6 lbs (3 kg). Click here for videos and more details on this packaging machine.

path: docs/Rollbag Baggers/4 - Medical Baggers/Rollbag Magnum Horizontal Medical Auto Bagger Quote 25.docx

subtitle.text: Automatic Bagging System for the Medical Industry

summary.text: The Rollbag Magnum Medical automatic bagger is designed for demanding cleanroom use, and for packaging products that will be processed in an autoclave or sterilizer. The Magnum Medical features validation ports, enabling the user to reliably conduct and document the sealing parameter validation process. To ensure 100% compliant seals, pressure and temperature sensors trigger alarms and halt sealing in the event these parameters drift out of predetermined values. The Magnum Medical is a revolutionary compact form/fill/seal system that creates pouches from tubing, Tyvek® rollstock, Medical Peel Paper, barrier material, and can be used with Rollbag™ pre-opened bags on a roll. Size changes and setup are a breeze using the job storage feature and large color touchscreen.

path: docs/Rollbag Baggers/4 - Medical Baggers/Rollbag R3200 HS Med Automatic Bagger Quote 25.docx

subtitle.text: Automatic Pouching System for Medical Products

summary.text: The Rollbag R3200 Med is a validatable pouching system for automatic packaging. The version of this machine will be designed to work with Tyvek/Poly rollstock with a pre-made chevron bottom seal. The machine will print identifying information on the Tyvek side, perforate and open the bag for loading, apply an 8mm wide top seal, and separate the finisehd pouch. Dry cycle speed estimate is around 15 bags/min. The R3200 Med automates the process of labeling, filling, and sealing medical products that are packaged in Tyvek pouches with a chevron seal and need to be sterilized. Click here for videos and more details on this packaging machine.
